design_notes.purpose: Self-contained paired experiment testing whether fungal phosphate construction cost creates a fungal P-limitation regime under low initial P and thereby controls plant biomass
design_notes.sampling: 50 matched continuous Latin-hypercube base conditions crossed with five fungal gamma_P values
design_notes.kappa_p: fixed at zero for plant and fungus

continuous_ranges.plant_kappa_c: 0.01x through 0.693145x of the default plant kappa_C, sampled logarithmically
continuous_ranges.fungus_kappa_c: 0.01x through 0.693145x of the default fungus kappa_C, sampled logarithmically
continuous_ranges.fungus_initial_biomass: 1x through 100x of the default initial AMF biomass, sampled logarithmically

design_notes.paired_factors: plant/fungus kappa_C, initial AMF biomass, both trade fractions, and initial P are identical within each five-run block; only fungal gamma_P changes
design_notes.common_random_numbers: same deterministic seed is used across matched gamma_P values
design_notes.interpretation: A fungal P-limitation regime is identified from the fraction of realised-growth timesteps labelled phosphate-limited in the fungal limitation trace; plant biomass, fungal biomass, and fungal P export are supporting outcomes
design_notes.outputs: Checkpoint JSON files contain limitation traces and cumulative C/P accounting; no combined result bundle is written
